scripts.dev: sh scripts/stack-up.sh && bun run --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.check: bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && bunx tsc --noEmit -p packages/db && bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && bunx eslint . && bunx prettier --check .
scripts.test: bun run --parallel test:shared test:db test:api test:web
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-custodia "cd apps/web && bun run test:rules:inner && cd ../../packages/shared && bun run test"
scripts.deploy:rules: bun run test:rules && firebase deploy --only firestore,storage
scripts.deploy:hosting: bun run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:rules && bun run deploy:hosting
